what_i_see: Near the selected position, a compact reddish core has a short, curved, relatively blue feature immediately south of it. No complete ring or clear counterimage is visible. Farther south lies a bright elongated galaxy beside a separate diagonal feature; that southern galaxy, not the selected source, dominates the zoom.
most_likely: An ordinary galaxy with asymmetric disk or spiral structure, or a close projected companion. The curved feature near the selected core makes strong lensing a secondary possibility.
against_it: The southern feature appears somewhat detached and tangential to the compact core, rather than clearly forming a continuous disk. Its apparent colour contrast warrants checking.
decisive_test: Inspect a WCS-centred cutout at the supplied coordinates, subtract the central galaxy light, and test whether the curved residual has matching-colour counterimages consistent with a lens model.
catalogue_notes: No SIMBAD match is supplied. NED lists WISEA J093606.14+735712.1 and WISEA J093605.73+735720.9 within 10 arcsec. The ECLIPSE strong-lens catalogue has zero entries; this does not exclude an uncatalogued lens.
note: Image and catalogue cross-match supplied; this reviewer did not query catalogues itself.
